title: Immortal Hounds
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In an alternate world where people revive after death, a disease called Resurrection Deficiency Syndrome makes its carriers, 'Vectors', able to die for good and to pass that mortality to others. Shin'ichi Kenzaki leads a police task force hunting Vectors, while a group called the Escape Artist helps them flee and seeks to end human immortality. A 7-volume seinen thriller published in English by Vertical.
life_message: Mortality, love and the value of a life become real again once death is no longer reversible.
